run_general_settings_key_audit: run the script to audit all general_settings keys used in the litellm codebase
extract_general_settings_keys: extract all general_settings.get and general_settings bracket keys from Python files in the repo
compare_documented_keys: compare code general_settings keys against the documented keys in config_settings.md
find_undocumented_keys: find and report any general_settings keys used in code but missing from documentation
parse_doc_table_keys: parse the general_settings reference table from the markdown documentation to extract documented keys
